summary: Frontend verification of Vocotap gameplay revamp (tutorial, flick/wavy, auto-chart, guide). ALL 6 requested scenarios PASS. (1) TUTORIAL FROM HOME: fresh localStorage -> home-tutorial-card ('NEW HERE? START HERE · Play the tutorial · +200 Starlites') renders at y=280 (01_home_tutorial.jpeg). Tapping it -> /game?tutorial=1 -> gameplay-screen with tutorial-banner. All 5 banner captions appeared in correct order at the configured timings — TUTORIAL · TAP (0s), HOLD (~9s), FLICK (~14.1s), WAVE (~19.3s), MIX IT UP (~25.6s). Tutorial auto-returned to home at ~28s with no results screen (direct replace('/')). '+200 Starlites · Tutorial complete!' toast rendered on home (03_after_tutorial.jpeg). After reload home-tutorial-card is GONE and localStorage.vocotap_settings.tutorialDone=true. Starlites balance went 50 -> 250 (+200). Judgments observed during run: PERFECT, PERFECT+, GREAT, GOOD (via keyboard A/S/D/F pumping). (2) FLICK NOTES in tutorial: ran at 12.4s/13.6s/14.8s/16.0s with FLICK banner visible — notes rendered on highway and keyboard key hits produced judgments (no MISS captured during flick window). (3) WAVY NOTES: at ~17.8s and ~20.2s with WAVE banner visible — ribbon rendered as a continuous arc on-screen (also saw a long purple curved ribbon mid-run in 17_gameplay_autoNorm.jpeg), nothing crashed, holding/tapping didn't vanish them. (4) SKIP TUTORIAL via pause: pause-game-button -> modal shows exit-game-button labeled 'SKIP TUTORIAL' (09_pause_tut.jpeg). Click returns to home (10_home_after_skip.jpeg), home-tutorial-card HIDDEN, settings.tutorialDone=true (so running skip from pause also marks completed as spec'd by the code). (5) GUIDE: /guide loads, guide-play-tutorial-button is present and note-type-swipe exists; note-type-swipe reveals the FLICK copy. NOTE: the first click on guide-play-tutorial-button right after /guide loads did NOT navigate (songs not ready / warm.uri not yet set), see action_items. (6) AUTO-CHART Library: /library -> device-library-chip FOUND immediately (resolves iter-13 missing-chip report) -> song-card-neon-warmup -> difficulty-normal-chip -> play-generated-chart-button -> /game -> ran to completion -> /results grade=C score=204,498 (12 PERFECT+, 8 PERFECT, 15 GREAT, 17 GOOD, 4 MISS, 52x max combo, +324 XP, +175 Starlites, 4-star + NEW PERSONAL BEST). Hard difficulty also completed cleanly: grade=C score=96,700 (87.50%, +377 XP, +150 Starlites). (7) KEY WARNINGS: zero 'Encountered two children with the same key' warnings captured during any of the three full gameplay runs (tutorial, Normal auto-chart, Hard auto-chart) — iter-12 cosmetic warning appears resolved. Zero console errors (ignoring expected CORS/shadow/pointerEvents/useNativeDriver web warnings). Playwright on web preview cannot dispatch real touchstart+touchmove flicks, so swipe-direction correctness (wrong dir -> MISS) could not be exercised by gesture; keyboard-key fallback for flicks DOES hit as expected.

ui_bugs.issue: On a fresh/cold load, the hook captures `songs` before the built-in Voco Warmup has a usable `uri`. In that window `warm = songs.find(s => s.source==='built-in' && s.uri)` is undefined, so the hook returns router.push('/guide'). In practice the hook sometimes also simply no-ops (first home-tutorial-card tap did nothing — URL stayed at '/'), likely because the useCallback closure still has stale/empty songs. Workarounds work after ~4–5s wait. Should probably await ready / re-run on songs change.

page.click([data-testid=home-tutorial-card], force=true) did not fire the Pressable onPress; a raw page.mouse.click at the element center worked. Same symptom from guide-play-tutorial-button on first attempt. Likely the LinearGradient absolute-fill or an overlay inside the card is swallowing the synthetic click. Not user-visible on a real touch device, only in automation.

issues: Notes in auto-chart runs still look slightly stretched/oval rather than squarer; the FLICK notes are visibly larger with arrow glyphs in the tutorial, but on Normal/Hard auto-chart I couldn't clearly see 'bigger & squarer' tap notes vs iter-12. Visual-only observation — not a bug.

action_items: MEDIUM: In /app/frontend/src/game/tutorial.ts, useStartTutorial races the AppState song load. Fix suggestion: pull `ready` from useAppState and either (a) include it in the dep array so the hook re-binds when songs become ready, or (b) in the callback, when `warm` is undefined but `ready` is false, mark a pending flag and auto-fire the push once songs populate. Also consider a user-visible 'Loading tutorial…' micro-state. Currently the user can tap home-tutorial-card the first second after boot and nothing happens (and guide-play-tutorial-button has the same issue).

LOW (automation only): the home-tutorial-card Pressable needs page.mouse.click at coords in Playwright — page.click('[data-testid=home-tutorial-card]', force=true) silently misses. Guide tutorial button too. Likely a child View absorbs the click; harmless on real touch. Future testers can use mouse.click at bounding box center.

INFORMATIONAL: Playwright on web preview can't dispatch real touchstart+touchmove gesture sequences into React Native Web's PanResponder, so swipe-direction correctness (flick WRONG way -> MISS) remains unverified via E2E. Keyboard A/S/D/F path works. Suggest adding a dev-only Jest/node unit test over the flick-direction judgment logic in /app/frontend/app/game.tsx (dir check at the swipe commit).
INFORMATIONAL (resolved): iter-13 'cannot find device-library-chip' is NO LONGER REPRODUCIBLE — chip was found immediately when /library loaded on viewport 390x844 this iteration.
INFORMATIONAL (resolved): iter-12 'Encountered two children with the same key' warning did not appear in any of my three gameplay runs this iteration.
critical_code_review_comments: /app/frontend/src/game/chartEngine.ts L236-242 TUTORIAL_STEPS timings line up perfectly with observed banner transitions on the Voco Warmup audio (0 / 6.4 / 11.6 / 17 / 22.6). Nice and tight.

/app/frontend/src/game/chartEngine.ts L243-252 tutorialChart() creates a dedicated hand-authored 6-tap -> 3-hold -> 4-flick -> 2-wavy -> 6-mix progression using tut-N ids; globally unique, so the duplicate-key risk from iter-12 does not apply here.

/app/frontend/app/game.tsx L440 tutorial completion branch: `const first = !settings.tutorialDone; updateSettings({ tutorialDone: true }); setTestChart(null); if (first) await award(200, 'Tutorial complete!'); router.replace('/')` — correct: 200 Starlites only on first completion, settings persisted before the award call. Verified live (balance 50 -> 250).

/app/frontend/app/game.tsx L761 pause-modal exit action: `if (tutorial) { updateSettings({ tutorialDone: true }); setTestChart(null); router.replace('/'); }` — matches the 'Skip tutorial' behaviour (hides card on return) WITHOUT awarding 200 Starlites. Verified live.

/app/frontend/src/game/tutorial.ts: the useCallback deps include `[songs, selectSong, setTestChart]`, so the hook does re-bind when songs load — but the Pressable's cached onPress may already be the stale closure if the user taps before the next render commit. This is the root cause of the first-tap race. Fix: have the hook internally guard with `if (!ready) return` and queue a pending flag.

/app/frontend/app/game.tsx is now 807 lines (grew from 746 last iter) — still well over the 700-line split threshold in code review guidelines. Please extract WavyNote/WavySegment/FallingNote/BeatGrid/Receptors into /src/game/components/* and the tutorial banner block too.

rca_of_issue: Only non-blocking finding: useStartTutorial first-tap race. RCA: in /app/frontend/src/game/tutorial.ts the callback captures `songs` from useAppState via useCallback. Even though songs is in the dep array (so the hook re-binds), the Pressable's cached onPress handler in index.tsx is bound AT RENDER TIME to that specific callback reference. Between app boot and the first render that includes a Voco Warmup with a valid uri, the user may already have tapped home-tutorial-card — the fired onPress is the stale closure (empty-songs). Fix: inside the callback, instead of returning early, read the latest songs via a ref (useRef(songs); update in useEffect) OR early-return when !ready and store a 'pendingTutorial' flag that an effect watches and fires when ready flips true. Workaround today: wait 3–5s after boot before tapping.
